description: Discovery Agent — vehicle shortlist for an advisor's customer. Prose cases run the one-shot assistant with agent_id=A1 (grounded Bedrock generation in agent mode over discovery.rank_vehicles facts; deterministic facts offline); the `A1.rank_vehicles` case goes through the AgentCore runtime tool dispatch, which also enforces journey scope. Journey J-US-J1 belongs to D-101 (advisor U-US-00002); J-US-J2 is another store's. Every figure in an answer must come from the facts (numbers_grounded); credit questions are refused before any model call.

cases.question: Which vehicles fit this customer's budget and family needs, and why?
Is the Ion C available in stock right now, and at what price?
What will the Ion C cost them to own over five years compared with a gas SUV?
Will this customer get approved for the Ion C at 1.9%?
